# Standards & federation

Shillinq declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `shillinq.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [OASIS UBL Invoice (e-invoice output)](https://docs.oasis-open.org/ubl/UBL-2.1.html) | 2.1 | Nextcloud login | — |
| EN 16931 European e-invoicing semantic model | 2017 | Nextcloud login | — |
| NLCIUS (Dutch CIUS of EN 16931) | 1.0 | Nextcloud login | — |
| [SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001.001.03) payment-run export](https://www.europeanpaymentscouncil.eu/what-we-do/sepa-credit-transfer) | pain.001.001.03 | Nextcloud login | — |
| XML Auditfile Financieel (XAF) export | 3.2 | Nextcloud login | — |
| [iCalendar (RFC 5545) appointment confirmations](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5545) | 2.0 | Nextcloud login | — |

## Standards this app uses

None.

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

Shillinq registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["shillinq"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `shillinq` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
